mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (openid, union_id, out_authorization_no, authorization_id) VALUES (#{openid}, #{unionId}, #{outAuthorizationNo}, #{authorizationId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET out_authorization_no = #{outAuthorizationNo}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE openid = #{openid}
